# Overcooked! 2 calibration fixtures

These OCR outputs come from the original 1920 x 1200 human recordings selected
by the operator: `human_play_13` (net 246, success) and `human_play_08` (net 219,
below the single-player three-star threshold of 220). `human_play_01` is excluded.

Full frame hashes, OCR output, versions and settlement artifacts are retained in
`out/overcooked_2_2_1_onboarding/replay_13_v1` and `replay_08_v1`. The test copies
exercise the measured result layout without loading GPU models. Modified numeric
copies in unit tests are boundary tests, not additional real-game evidence.
